sentences.text:
The petitioners have called in question the notice issued to them under Section 9 of Land
Acquisition Act, 1894 calling upon them to put forth their claims in relation to their interest in the
land so as to determine compensation and declare award.

2.  It transpires from the record that in the past, different petitioners had filed different petitions and most of them were dismissed/disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to seek remedy after the compensation amount is determined.

sentences.text: We find that apart from the defect of multifariousness, the petitioners also do not have any cause of action to challenge the impugned notice, which only require them to put forth their claims in relation to the compensation etc.
In case, the petitioners do not feel satisfied with the award ultimately passed, it shall always be open to them to assail the same in appropriate proceedings.
4. Consequently, the petition is dismissed with the aforesaid liberty reserved in favour of the petitioners.
